tools.description:
Returns the free dates of a space (and the free hours of that day, if it is sold by the hour).

Hours are in 24h format and in the VENUE'S LOCAL TIME, never UTC: the IANA time zone is in the `timezone` field of the response.

tools.name: get_booking_link
tools.description:
Returns the booking link on desky.la for a space, with the date and number of people already filled in.

It does not book or charge: the person sees the final price and confirms on the site. It is the final action of this server, and that is context for you: sharing the link is enough.

tools.name: quote_booking
tools.description:
Quotes a specific booking and returns the final total and the checkout link.

The Desky interface uses it when the person changes the date or the number of seats. The total comes from the same calculation as the site's checkout, so it is the final number and not an estimate.

tools.name: search_coworks
tools.description: Searches workspaces published on Desky by city, neighborhood, type, capacity and price range. For each one it returns its id, name, coworking, location, starting price with its unit (per day for desks and offices, per hour for rooms: see `price_from_period`), amenities and a ready-made booking URL.
